ORDINANCE XLIV OF

PATENTS (SECOND
AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2007
An Ordinance further to
amend the
Patents Ordinance, 2000
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part I,
7th September, 2007]
No.2(1)/2007-Pub.,
dated 7-9-2009.---The following Ordinance promulgated by the President is
hereby published for general information:--
Whereas it is expedient further to amend
the Patents Ordinance, 2000 (LXI of 2000);
And whereas the National Assembly is not
in session and the President is satisfied that circumstances exist which render
it necessary to take immediately action.
Now therefore, in exercise of the powers
conferred by clause (1) of Article 89 of the Constitution of the Islamic
Republic of Pakistan, the President is pleased to make and promulgate the following
Ordinance:--
1. Short title and commencement.---(1) This Ordinance may be called the Patents (Second Amendment)
Ordinance, 2007.
(2) It shall come into force at once and
shall be deemed to have taken effect on the 18th day of August, 2007.

(a) in subsection (2), the comma and
words ", but before the period of eighteen months from the date of filing
of application in Pakistan"
shall be omitted and shall be deemed always to have been so omitted; and
(b) subsection
(6) shall be omitted.
